name: LogRocket

evidence.replay: F02: primary category is session replay with product analytics; F17: DOM-based web replay with click, scroll and conversion maps
evidence.web: F15: page views, sessions, landing and last pages, referrers, country and UTM groupings
evidence.product: F16: custom events with forward and reverse path analysis; F15: single and cross-session funnels

line: Records app sessions and connects user behavior to frontend problems.

free.text: Free up to 1,000 sessions a month

cells.cookieless: No, web sessions use first-party cookies
cells.location: US for SaaS; self-hosted location is customer-selected

pv.math: Billed by sessions. The free plan covers 1,000 a month. Core starts at $83 a month, billed yearly, for 10,000 sessions.
